dashboard.restartBody: If it does not work out, connect again.
dashboard.competingBody: Two tunnels at once break DNS and the internet. Keep one: our VPN or the other client.
dashboard.leakBody: Turn the VPN on; if it is on already, choose another server.
dashboard.recheckFailed: Could not check the kill switch
dashboard.releaseFailed: Could not remove the kill switch
dashboard.engineTitle: The engine that carries the connection, and why it was chosen

foreignVpn.title: Another VPN detected
foreignVpn.body: While it runs, pings are off: its adapter answers for every server. Quit it to see the real latencies.

allowVpn.body: While “Always” is on, this VPN cannot go online. Allow its program?

pause.title: Internet paused
pause.manual: Automatic reconnect is off — press Connect.
pause.nextAttempt: The VPN is reconnecting… next attempt in {{wait}}
pause.keyRejected: The server rejects the key: update the key or the subscription.

noPause.title: Another VPN
noPause.body: All traffic already goes through it, so the internet does not pause if our VPN drops.

proxyTaken.title: System proxy
proxyTaken.body: Another program changed it: browsers bypass the VPN now.
